mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pages (name, workspace_id, parent_id, owner_id, content) VALUES (#{page.name}, #{page.workspaceId}, #{page.parentId}, #{page.ownerId}, #{page.content});
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pages WHERE id = #{pageId} AND owner_id = #{ownerId};
mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM pages p LEFT JOIN pages parent ON p.parent_id = parent.id WHERE p.archived = TRUE AND (p.parent_id IS NULL OR parent.archived = FALSE) AND owner_id = #{ownerId};
